steps.what: Inspect teaching materials and identify classroom shortages
Retrieve supplies and restock teaching materials at classroom locations

tasks.design: Keep classroom inspection and physical replenishment with the substitute teacher. An existing room guide in {DOCS} can identify storage locations, but this design adds no application or automatic stock decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: The materials must be found, checked and carried to their teaching locations.
tasks.enabler_now: An existing room guide may make an unfamiliar classroom easier to navigate; no new labour saving is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: The substitute must judge which materials are missing, usable and appropriate for the planned lesson.
tasks.human_edge: Notice damaged supplies and immediate classroom needs while physically replenishing them.
tasks.altitude: Restocking duties and decision rights stay the same.

reach.learn: Learn room storage locations and safe handling of lesson materials.

evidence.claim: Physical classroom replenishment requires inspection and handling; a stock record alone does not perform that work.

assumptions: Boundary is local replenishment from existing school supplies; buying materials and central stock management remain separate tasks with unchanged ownership.

The regular teacher supplies lesson requirements before s1. The substitute produces observed shortages during the time counted in s1; no structured shortage flag, par level or inventory feed is presumed.
The substitute finds and checks available storeroom supplies during s2. Missing guides or uncertain quantities are resolved by direct inspection within the retained human work.
Native document access is sufficient if a room guide already exists; no custom system is proposed.
Incremental upkeep is zero because there is no new tool, record, integration or maintenance duty. Updating existing room guidance is outside this unchanged task and earns no saving.
unknowns: Which supplies substitutes may retrieve independently
research_questions: How much restocking time is physical retrieval versus finding the correct storage location?

already_counted.description: Physical inspection, shortage identification and replenishment remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No changed process or new upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100; gross and net saving are zero with zero incremental upkeep. Physical inspection and retrieval remain unchanged, including when storage guidance is absent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The substitute still replenishes materials needed for the lesson.
reach: Coordinate classroom preparation with teaching assistants.
role.ambitious_version: No expanded service or decision right is claimed for this physical task.
